The Backstage Scaffolder (Software Templates) REST API provides endpoints for creating, managing, and monitoring scaffolder tasks. It enables programmatic execution of software templates to bootstrap new projects, components, and other software assets. The API supports task creation, status monitoring via event streams, listing available actions, and dry-run capabilities for testing templates.
